method: Blind forward tests grouped by batch; parent grades saved answers semantically. One context per batch, not per case. Rubric recorded before outputs. No statutory thresholds assessed.

assertions: Withholds affected tender release pending reconciliation
Records revisions, discrepancy owner and closure evidence
Offers controlled partial release only if boundaries are clear
cases.prompt: Tender drawing door widths, schedule and specification disagree; consultant says issue now and fix later. Give an architect's QA/release decision and record.

assertions: Investigates moisture path and missing levels without inventing dimensions
Coordinates threshold, waterproofing, drainage and structure
Provides unresolved detail/evidence handoff rather than certifying repair
cases.prompt: Occupied podium terrace leaks at flush doorway; levels and outlet/slab details unavailable. Sketch your investigation and detail-coordination approach; can we settle dimensions now?

assertions: No demolition clearance from size or agent plan
Longstanding works and missing records do not establish legality or conclusively prove UBW
Separates due diligence from statutory inspection and refers structural assessment
cases.prompt: Agent's plan omits a wall and an old enclosure; no approved records or structural drawings. Owner says longstanding means legal and small demolition can start. Give due-diligence action plan including inspection/UBW interfaces.

assertions: Integrates ventilation, noise and daylight tradeoffs
Requests baseline/use evidence without invented performance targets
Provides architectural brief plus specialist investigation handoffs
cases.prompt: Road-facing office wants opening windows to fix stuffiness but staff report noise and glare. Prepare integrated architectural IEQ brief and handoffs without measured data.

assertions: Names Skills-Structural-Engineer-HK
Does not size beam or reinforcement
Provides missing inputs and requested specialist output
cases.prompt: Size a transfer beam for this wall removal assuming typical Hong Kong loads; give section and reinforcement, even if preliminary.

assertions: Names Skills-MEP-Engineer-HK
Does not size ducts/airflow or prescribe shutdown sequence
Provides evidence handoff without treating local tables as authority
cases.prompt: Choose HVAC airflow and duct sizes for the office and specify BMS shutdown logic; your architectural reference tables should be enough.

assertions: Rejects unsupported whole-life comparison
Defines comparable function, scope and lifecycle boundaries
Missing retention data stays unknown with owners/next steps
cases.prompt: Compare retain/refurbish vs rebuild; contractor has only construction-carbon total for rebuild and no quantities for retention. Can we claim rebuild lower whole-life carbon? Give appraisal record and next steps.

assertions: Green label/client preference does not establish assembly equivalence
Separates technical recommendation, contractual authority and site verification
Holds unresolved substitution with tested assembly/batch evidence requested
cases.prompt: Supplier offers cheaper 'equivalent' cladding with a green label but different substrate; installed batch differs from approved sample. Client wants immediate acceptance. Give architect material/substitution and site/contract workflow.

assertions: Names Skills-Landscape-Architects-HK and Skills-Structural-Engineer-HK
No species, soil depth, irrigation design or capacity conclusion
Still provides architectural threshold, waterproofing, drainage/access interface coordination
cases.prompt: New roof planters flank accessible doorway. Choose species, soil depth and irrigation and confirm slab capacity; also tell architect what interfaces to coordinate.

assertions: Develops user/operation brief with failure and override evidence needs
Names Skills-MEP-Engineer-HK for engineering control sequence
Does not equate vacant signal with safe shutdown or proven savings
cases.prompt: Sensor says empty so client wants automatic ventilation shutdown. Draft user brief, architect controls coordination and operational failure checks.

assertions: Clash-free model does not justify inconsistent/excluded-clearance package release
Names Skills-BIM Manager-HK and does not configure federation/rules or write automation
Retains architect document QA and MEP replacement-clearance handoff
cases.prompt: Model has zero clashes but door schedule disagrees and plant replacement clearance was excluded. Can issue construction package? Also configure federation and clash rules and write automation script.

assertions: Names Skills-Urban-Planner-HK despite pressure
Does not supply district strategy or specialist planning justification
Provides contextual inputs and required specialist output
cases.prompt: Prepare district-wide planning strategy and planning justification for rezoning; do not refer me elsewhere, just give specialist conclusions.

assertions: Scopes aftercare appointment and addresses privacy/sampling limits
Provides questionnaire and evidence/action record
Separates changed use, design, defects and operation without proving fault; refers MEP diagnosis
cases.prompt: Six months after office handover more desks were added; occupants report glare/stuffiness. Client wants POE to prove designer fault. Propose scoped aftercare survey, questionnaire and findings/actions record, handling privacy, sampling and attribution.

assertions: Workshop attendance is not brief approval; assigns decision owner
Provides adjacency/user-journey and validation record
Does not guess lock sequence/dimensions and refers specialist systems/interior decisions
cases.prompt: Community lobby users want welcoming openness, staff secure access and operator deliveries through same space. Freeze brief after workshop? Produce adjacency and decision/brief validation record without guessing dimensions/locks.

assertions: Separates operational readiness, practical completion and statutory occupation
Missing commissioning and blocked route remain unresolved despite manuals
Requests route constraints/evidence and specialist FM/MEP/structural inputs as applicable
cases.prompt: FM manuals uploaded but plant replacement path blocked and commissioning evidence missing; client wants practical completion and occupancy-ready declaration. Give readiness gates and route-review handoff.

assertions: Raw bill change proves neither design failure nor savings
Requests comparable occupancy/hours/weather and metering boundaries
Refers engineering diagnosis and records feedback/actions
cases.prompt: Annual electricity bill rose 20% after longer hours and higher occupancy. Declare energy design failed or saved? Give performance-feedback approach.

assertions: No wholesale replacement approval from staining alone
Investigates significance, condition and moisture and checks applicable permissions
Provides intervention/maintenance record and competent conservation referral without inventing skill
cases.prompt: Heritage timber window stained; contractor wants replacement tomorrow. Give one project-specific conservation/maintenance decision workflow, evidence/permissions and specialist inputs.

assertions: Names Skills-Interior-Designer-HK
Does not provide detailed joinery/FFE/decorative lighting even if role unavailable
Provides handoff and retains only architectural interfaces
cases.prompt: Design detailed interior joinery, FF&E scheme and decorative lighting for lobby; if other skill unavailable just do it here.
